proposed_claim: Under a shared action-conditioned world model, authentic source-task trajectories can selectively reshape the shared model's interpolation geometry around the source's visited state-action manifold, so a target task's unvisited action comparisons are ranked incorrectly after source exit even when target one-step latent error and actor are nearly unchanged; reverse-path and matched action-multiset controls remove the effect.

new_evidence.native_horizon3: cheetah-run ordered cascade -> walker-run MPC loss 19.1%/19.3% on seeds31/32; reverse loss 6.0%/0.5%; shuffled approximately no loss; one-step error ratio 0.922; dynamics-only, actor unchanged
new_evidence.one_step_training: same legal source conditions but adaptation consistency window forced to 1 step: cascade loss 12.4%/16.0%; reverse 6.9%/3.6%; shuffled -0.1%/+1.1%; cascade one-step error ratio 1.011; actor unchanged
new_evidence.negative_mechanism_tests: latent power/Jacobian non-normality not source-selective; A/B update commutator not cascade-specific; planner rank drop only one seed; actor-restored native_full loses the two-seed effect; Q-only adaptation gives no selective cascade harm; latent-projection short gate cascade return exceeds random and target power norm is unchanged

carrier: official TD-MPC2 mt30-48M, authentic legal cheetah source, native walker-run MPC
known_boundary: Do not call this generic non-IID negative transfer, occupancy shift, rollout compounding, SWAAP/TRAP/data poisoning, or ordinary dynamics misfit. Need a named mediator that can be measured and a useful intervention/defense.
